title: 里翁—安提里翁大橋
summary: 里翁—安提里翁大橋以 286+3×560+286 m 共 2,252 m 的連續全懸吊橋面跨越希臘科林斯灣口，四座塔立在直徑 90 m、坐於 3 m 礫石層上的基礎，下方以 2 m 鋼管插入物加勁軟弱海床。本課從 0.48 g 地震與 2 m 斷層位移、熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器、加勁土壤與沉箱浮運，到張力腿駁船的海床整備、平衡懸臂架設、WEASHM 監測、雷擊斷索與混凝土耐久。
summaryEn: The Rion–Antirion Bridge crosses the mouth of the Gulf of Corinth with a 2,252 m continuous fully suspended deck of 286+3×560+286 m; its four pylons stand on 90 m diameter footings resting on a 3 m gravel layer above soft seabed reinforced with 2 m steel-pipe inclusions. The course runs from 0.48 g shaking and 2 m fault movement, fuse restrainers and viscous dampers, reinforced soil and floating caissons, to seabed preparation from a tension-leg barge, balanced-cantilever erection, the WEASHM monitoring system, the lightning-caused stay failure and concrete durability.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求」與「連續全懸吊橋面：熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait" and "Continuous suspended deck: fuse restrainers and viscous dampers": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「墩間相對位移」如何影響里翁—安提里翁大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Relative pier movement” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rion–Antirion Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 橋址位於構造活躍的科林斯灣，營運單位公開的設計條件包括：地表尖峰加速度 0.48 g、0.2 至 1.0 s 週期的最大譜加速度 1.2 g、回歸期 2,000 年（120 年設計年限內 5% 超越機率），且相鄰橋墩之間須容許任何方向達 2 m 的斷層相對位移，塔的傾斜容許 1/500。這些需求使傳統「把結構牢牢固定」的做法行不通：基礎必須能在海床上滑移，橋面必須與塔分離懸吊，讓地震與構造位移由可控制的滑動、擺動與阻尼吸收，而不是由構件強度硬抗。最不利的設計組合是設計地震加上 50% 的構造位移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「墩間相對位移」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The site lies in the tectonically active Gulf of Corinth. The operator’s published design criteria include a peak ground acceleration of 0.48 g, maximum spectral acceleration of 1.2 g for periods of 0.2 to 1.0 s, a 2,000-year return period (5% exceedance in the 120-year design life), up to 2 m of fault movement in any direction between adjacent piers and a pylon tilt allowance of 1/500. These demands rule out simply fixing the structure firmly: the foundations must be able to slide on the seabed and the deck must hang free of the pylons, so that seismic and tectonic movement is absorbed by controlled sliding, swinging and damping rather than resisted by member strength. The governing combination is the design earthquake plus 50% of the tectonic movements. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Relative pier movement” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若海峽以每年約 12.5 mm 擴張，120 年累積 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m；與 2 m 容許相對位移相比剩餘 0.5 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If the strait widens by about 12.5 mm a year, 120 years accumulate 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m, leaving 0.5 m of the 2 m allowance.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抗震設計的最佳做法永遠是把結構做得更強、更固定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The best seismic design is always to make the structure stronger and more rigidly fixed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「墩間相對位移」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Relative pier movement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求
knowledge.titleEn: Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait
knowledge.text: 橋址位於構造活躍的科林斯灣，營運單位公開的設計條件包括：地表尖峰加速度 0.48 g、0.2 至 1.0 s 週期的最大譜加速度 1.2 g、回歸期 2,000 年（120 年設計年限內 5% 超越機率），且相鄰橋墩之間須容許任何方向達 2 m 的斷層相對位移，塔的傾斜容許 1/500。這些需求使傳統「把結構牢牢固定」的做法行不通：基礎必須能在海床上滑移，橋面必須與塔分離懸吊，讓地震與構造位移由可控制的滑動、擺動與阻尼吸收，而不是由構件強度硬抗。
knowledge.textEn: The site lies in the tectonically active Gulf of Corinth. The operator’s published design criteria include a peak ground acceleration of 0.48 g, maximum spectral acceleration of 1.2 g for periods of 0.2 to 1.0 s, a 2,000-year return period (5% exceedance in the 120-year design life), up to 2 m of fault movement in any direction between adjacent piers and a pylon tilt allowance of 1/500.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：抗震設計的最佳做法永遠是把結構做得更強、更固定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The best seismic design is always to make the structure stronger and more rigidly fixed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「里翁—安提里翁大橋」的「地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求：機制與傳力路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出載重來源、構件、接點與支承的傳力邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「跨河橋梁試載日」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與幾何版本、支承條件、荷載方向與獨立位移紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait: mechanism and load path” in “Rion–Antirion Bridge”. Draw the load, member, connection and support load paths; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Bridge proof-test day” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for geometry revision, supports, load direction and independent displacement records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait" is correct?
options: 抗震設計的最佳做法永遠是把結構做得更強、更固定。
橋址位於構造活躍的科林斯灣，營運單位公開的設計條件包括：地表尖峰加速度 0.48 g、0.2 至 1.0 s 週期的最大譜加速度 1.2 g、回歸期 2,000 年（120 年設計年限內 5% 超越機率），且相鄰橋墩之間須容許任何方向達 2 m 的斷層相對位移，塔的傾斜容許 1/500。
橋面懸吊在塔上自由擺動，地震時就不需要任何阻尼裝置。
optionsEn: The best seismic design is always to make the structure stronger and more rigidly fixed.
The site lies in the tectonically active Gulf of Corinth.
If the deck hangs freely from the pylons, it needs no damping devices in an earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 橋址位於構造活躍的科林斯灣，營運單位公開的設計條件包括：地表尖峰加速度 0.48 g、0.2 至 1.0 s 週期的最大譜加速度 1.2 g、回歸期 2,000 年（120 年設計年限內 5% 超越機率），且相鄰橋墩之間須容許任何方向達 2 m 的斷層相對位移，塔的傾斜容許 1/500。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The site lies in the tectonically active Gulf of Corinth. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「墩間相對位移」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Relative pier movement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若海峽以每年約 12.5 mm 擴張，120 年累積 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m；與 2 m 容許相對位移相比剩餘 0.5 m。若擴張速率取 15 mm/年，累積 1.8 m，餘裕只剩 0.2 m，說明構造位移與地震位移需一併規劃。擴張速率為教學假設，2 m 為公開設計值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If the strait widens by about 12.5 mm a year, 120 years accumulate 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m, leaving 0.5 m of the 2 m allowance. At 15 mm a year the total is 1.8 m with only 0.2 m to spare, showing that tectonic and seismic displacements must be planned together. The widening rate is a teaching assumption; 2 m is the published design value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以場址特定地震危害分析建立設計譜與時間歷程，進行含基礎滑移與橋面擺動的非線性時間歷程分析；以岸邊與墩位的測地網定期量測實際構造位移，與設計假設的速率比較，必要時更新剩餘容量評估。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build design spectra and time histories from a site-specific seismic hazard analysis and run nonlinear time-history analyses including foundation sliding and deck swinging; measure actual tectonic movement periodically with a geodetic network on the shores and at the piers, compare with the assumed rate and update the remaining-capacity assessment when needed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若海峽以每年約 12.5 mm 擴張，120 年累積 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m；與 2 m 容許相對位移相比剩餘 0.5 m。若擴張速率取 15 mm/年，累積 1.8 m，餘裕只剩 0.2 m，說明構造位移與地震位移需一併規劃。擴張速率為教學假設，2 m 為公開設計值。
knowledge.textEn: If the strait widens by about 12.5 mm a year, 120 years accumulate 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m, leaving 0.5 m of the 2 m allowance. At 15 mm a year the total is 1.8 m with only 0.2 m to spare, showing that tectonic and seismic displacements must be planned together. The widening rate is a teaching assumption; 2 m is the published design value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土結構太重，不可能在海上浮運。
平衡懸臂只要最後兩側長度相同，中間的施工順序不重要。
若海峽以每年約 12.5 mm 擴張，120 年累積 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m；與 2 m 容許相對位移相比剩餘 0.5 m。
optionsEn: Concrete structures are too heavy to float and tow at sea.
In balanced cantilever erection only the final equal lengths matter, not the order in between.
If the strait widens by about 12.5 mm a year, 120 years accumulate 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m, leaving 0.5 m of the 2 m allowance.
quiz.explanation: 若海峽以每年約 12.5 mm 擴張，120 年累積 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m；與 2 m 容許相對位移相比剩餘 0.5 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If the strait widens by about 12.5 mm a year, 120 years accumulate 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m, leaving 0.5 m of the 2 m allowance. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「墩間相對位移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Relative pier movement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以場址特定地震危害分析建立設計譜與時間歷程，進行含基礎滑移與橋面擺動的非線性時間歷程分析；以岸邊與墩位的測地網定期量測實際構造位移，與設計假設的速率比較，必要時更新剩餘容量評估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build design spectra and time histories from a site-specific seismic hazard analysis and run nonlinear time-history analyses including foundation sliding and deck swinging; measure actual tectonic movement periodically with a geodetic network on the shores and at the piers, compare with the assumed rate and update the remaining-capacity assessment when needed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計基準文件要同時列出地震、構造位移、溫度與風的位移需求，並以「位移預算」逐項分配給基礎滑移、阻尼器行程、伸縮縫與支承；任何預算超支都需設計者書面確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis should list displacement demands from earthquake, tectonic movement, temperature and wind together and allocate them in a displacement budget to foundation sliding, damper stroke, joints and bearings; any overrun requires the designer’s written confirmation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把基礎嵌固、橋面固定在塔上，地震力會直接灌入塔與基礎，構造位移則在固定點累積成巨大的強迫應力；相鄰墩的相對位移若超過伸縮縫與阻尼器行程，橋面可能撞擊或脫落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fixing the foundations and tying the deck to the pylons would drive seismic force straight into pylons and footings while tectonic movement accumulated as huge locked-in stresses; relative pier movement beyond joint and damper travel could make the deck collide or unseat. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以場址特定地震危害分析建立設計譜與時間歷程，進行含基礎滑移與橋面擺動的非線性時間歷程分析；以岸邊與墩位的測地網定期量測實際構造位移，與設計假設的速率比較，必要時更新剩餘容量評估。
knowledge.textEn: Build design spectra and time histories from a site-specific seismic hazard analysis and run nonlinear time-history analyses including foundation sliding and deck swinging; measure actual tectonic movement periodically with a geodetic network on the shores and at the piers, compare with the assumed rate and update the remaining-capacity assessment when needed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計基準文件要同時列出地震、構造位移、溫度與風的位移需求，並以「位移預算」逐項分配給基礎滑移、阻尼器行程、伸縮縫與支承；任何預算超支都需設計者書面確認。
knowledge.textEn: The design basis should list displacement demands from earthquake, tectonic movement, temperature and wind together and allocate them in a displacement budget to foundation sliding, damper stroke, joints and bearings; any overrun requires the designer’s written confirmation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait"?
options: 以場址特定地震危害分析建立設計譜與時間歷程，進行含基礎滑移與橋面擺動的非線性時間歷程分析。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
有了即時感測器，就不需要定期做傳統測量。
optionsEn: Build design spectra and time histories from a site-specific seismic hazard analysis and run nonlinear time-history analyses including foundation sliding and deck swinging.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
With real-time sensors there is no need for periodic conventional surveys.
quiz.explanation: 以場址特定地震危害分析建立設計譜與時間歷程，進行含基礎滑移與橋面擺動的非線性時間歷程分析；以岸邊與墩位的測地網定期量測實際構造位移，與設計假設的速率比較，必要時更新剩餘容量評估。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build design spectra and time histories from a site-specific seismic hazard analysis and run nonlinear time-history analyses including foundation sliding and deck swinging; measure actual tectonic movement periodically with a geodetic network on the shores and at the piers, compare with the assumed rate and update the remaining-capacity assessment when needed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「墩間相對位移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Relative pier movement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把基礎嵌固、橋面固定在塔上，地震力會直接灌入塔與基礎，構造位移則在固定點累積成巨大的強迫應力；相鄰墩的相對位移若超過伸縮縫與阻尼器行程，橋面可能撞擊或脫落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Fixing the foundations and tying the deck to the pylons would drive seismic force straight into pylons and footings while tectonic movement accumulated as huge locked-in stresses; relative pier movement beyond joint and damper travel could make the deck collide or unseat. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：最不利的設計組合是設計地震加上 50% 的構造位移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The governing combination is the design earthquake plus 50% of the tectonic movements.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「抗震設計的最佳做法永遠是把結構做得更強、更固定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The best seismic design is always to make the structure stronger and more rigidly fixed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把基礎嵌固、橋面固定在塔上，地震力會直接灌入塔與基礎，構造位移則在固定點累積成巨大的強迫應力；相鄰墩的相對位移若超過伸縮縫與阻尼器行程，橋面可能撞擊或脫落。
knowledge.textEn: Fixing the foundations and tying the deck to the pylons would drive seismic force straight into pylons and footings while tectonic movement accumulated as huge locked-in stresses; relative pier movement beyond joint and damper travel could make the deck collide or unseat.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若把基礎嵌固、橋面固定在塔上，地震力會直接灌入塔與基礎，構造位移則在固定點累積成巨大的強迫應力；相鄰墩的相對位移若超過伸縮縫與阻尼器行程，橋面可能撞擊或脫落。
橋面懸吊在塔上自由擺動，地震時就不需要任何阻尼裝置。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Fixing the foundations and tying the deck to the pylons would drive seismic force straight into pylons and footings while tectonic movement accumulated as huge locked-in stresses.
If the deck hangs freely from the pylons, it needs no damping devices in an earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 若把基礎嵌固、橋面固定在塔上，地震力會直接灌入塔與基礎，構造位移則在固定點累積成巨大的強迫應力；相鄰墩的相對位移若超過伸縮縫與阻尼器行程，橋面可能撞擊或脫落。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fixing the foundations and tying the deck to the pylons would drive seismic force straight into pylons and footings while tectonic movement accumulated as huge locked-in stresses; relative pier movement beyond joint and damper travel could make the deck collide or unseat. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 連續全懸吊橋面：熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Continuous suspended deck: fuse restrainers and viscous dampers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「熔斷限制器」如何影響里翁—安提里翁大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fuse restrainers” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rion–Antirion Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 里翁—安提里翁大橋的橋面在全長 2,252 m 連續，並完全由斜索懸吊，不直接坐在塔上，地震時橋面像巨大的擺錘相對塔擺動。營運單位公開的配置是：主墩設 10.5 MN、過渡墩設 3.5 MN 的熔斷限制器，平時在強風下把橋面固定，地震時降伏斷開；同時並聯每支 3.5 MN 的黏滯阻尼器，塔位 4 支、過渡墩 2 支，主墩行程 −1,650 至 +1,850 mm，過渡墩 ±2,600 mm。熔斷限制器提供常時剛度，阻尼器在熔斷後限制擺幅並消耗能量，兩者分工讓風與地震的需求不必用同一個元件妥協。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「熔斷限制器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Rion–Antirion deck is continuous over its full 2,252 m and fully suspended by stays rather than resting on the pylons, so in an earthquake it swings like a giant pendulum relative to them. The operator’s published layout has fuse restrainers of 10.5 MN at the main piers and 3.5 MN at the transition piers that hold the deck in strong wind and yield in an earthquake, in parallel with viscous dampers of 3.5 MN each, 4 at the pylons and 2 at the transition piers, with strokes of −1,650 to +1,850 mm at main piers and ±2,600 mm at transition piers. The fuses provide everyday stiffness and the dampers limit swing and dissipate energy after the fuses break, so wind and seismic demands need not be compromised in one device. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fuse restrainers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Damper force F = C·v^α; with α = 0.15 and F = 3,500 kN at v = 1.6 m/s, C = 3,500/1.6^0.15 ≈ 3,262 kN/(m/s)^0.15, and at v = 0.1 m/s F ≈ 3,262×0.708 ≈ 2,309 kN: a sixteen-fold drop in speed lowers force by only about 34%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋面懸吊在塔上自由擺動，地震時就不需要任何阻尼裝置。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the deck hangs freely from the pylons, it needs no damping devices in an earthquake." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「熔斷限制器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Fuse restrainers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 連續全懸吊橋面：熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器
knowledge.titleEn: Continuous suspended deck: fuse restrainers and viscous dampers
knowledge.text: 里翁—安提里翁大橋的橋面在全長 2,252 m 連續，並完全由斜索懸吊，不直接坐在塔上，地震時橋面像巨大的擺錘相對塔擺動。營運單位公開的配置是：主墩設 10.5 MN、過渡墩設 3.5 MN 的熔斷限制器，平時在強風下把橋面固定，地震時降伏斷開；同時並聯每支 3.5 MN 的黏滯阻尼器，塔位 4 支、過渡墩 2 支，主墩行程 −1,650 至 +1,850 mm，過渡墩 ±2,600 mm。
knowledge.textEn: The Rion–Antirion deck is continuous over its full 2,252 m and fully suspended by stays rather than resting on the pylons, so in an earthquake it swings like a giant pendulum relative to them. The operator’s published layout has fuse restrainers of 10.5 MN at the main piers and 3.5 MN at the transition piers that hold the deck in strong wind and yield in an earthquake, in parallel with viscous dampers of 3.5 MN each, 4 at the pylons and 2 at the transition piers, with strokes of −1,650 to +1,850 mm at main piers and ±2,600 mm at transition piers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橋面懸吊在塔上自由擺動，地震時就不需要任何阻尼裝置。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the deck hangs freely from the pylons, it needs no damping devices in an earthquake. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「連續全懸吊橋面：熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Continuous suspended deck: fuse restrainers and viscous dampers" is correct?
options: 橋面懸吊在塔上自由擺動，地震時就不需要任何阻尼裝置。
軟弱海床上的大橋基礎一定要用長樁打到岩盤。
里翁—安提里翁大橋的橋面在全長 2,252 m 連續，並完全由斜索懸吊，不直接坐在塔上，地震時橋面像巨大的擺錘相對塔擺動。
optionsEn: If the deck hangs freely from the pylons, it needs no damping devices in an earthquake.
Bridge foundations on soft seabed must always use long piles driven to rock.
The Rion–Antirion deck is continuous over its full 2,252 m and fully suspended by stays rather than resting on the pylons, so in an earthquake it swings like a giant pendulum relative to them.
quiz.explanation: 里翁—安提里翁大橋的橋面在全長 2,252 m 連續，並完全由斜索懸吊，不直接坐在塔上，地震時橋面像巨大的擺錘相對塔擺動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Rion–Antirion deck is continuous over its full 2,252 m and fully suspended by stays rather than resting on the pylons, so in an earthquake it swings like a giant pendulum relative to them. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 連續全懸吊橋面：熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Continuous suspended deck: fuse restrainers and viscous dampers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熔斷限制器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fuse restrainers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：阻尼力 F = C·v^α，取 α = 0.15、在 v = 1.6 m/s 時 F = 3,500 kN：C = 3,500/1.6^0.15 ≈ 3,262 kN/(m/s)^0.15；v = 0.1 m/s 時 F ≈ 3,262×0.708 ≈ 2,309 kN，速度降為 1/16 力只降約 34%。主墩熔斷力 10.5 MN 是單支阻尼器容量的 3 倍。α 與速度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Damper force F = C·v^α; with α = 0.15 and F = 3,500 kN at v = 1.6 m/s, C = 3,500/1.6^0.15 ≈ 3,262 kN/(m/s)^0.15, and at v = 0.1 m/s F ≈ 3,262×0.708 ≈ 2,309 kN: a sixteen-fold drop in speed lowers force by only about 34%. The 10.5 MN main-pier fuse is 3 times one damper’s capacity. α and velocities are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：熔斷元件以抽樣破壞試驗確認斷開力在設計範圍內，阻尼器做全尺寸力—速度與行程試驗；營運期以限制器上的荷重計長期記錄風力與溫度造成的力，確認遠低於熔斷值；地震後依荷重計資料判斷是否需要更換熔斷元件並重新校準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm fuse break force by sample destructive tests and test dampers full-size for force–velocity and stroke; in service record wind- and temperature-induced forces on the restrainer load cells to confirm they stay well below the fuse value, and after an earthquake use the load-cell data to decide whether fuses must be replaced and recalibrated.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 阻尼力 F = C·v^α，取 α = 0.15、在 v = 1.6 m/s 時 F = 3,500 kN：C = 3,500/1.6^0.15 ≈ 3,262 kN/(m/s)^0.15；v = 0.1 m/s 時 F ≈ 3,262×0.708 ≈ 2,309 kN，速度降為 1/16 力只降約 34%。主墩熔斷力 10.5 MN 是單支阻尼器容量的 3 倍。α 與速度為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Damper force F = C·v^α; with α = 0.15 and F = 3,500 kN at v = 1.6 m/s, C = 3,500/1.6^0.15 ≈ 3,262 kN/(m/s)^0.15, and at v = 0.1 m/s F ≈ 3,262×0.708 ≈ 2,309 kN: a sixteen-fold drop in speed lowers force by only about 34%. The 10.5 MN main-pier fuse is 3 times one damper’s capacity. α and velocities are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「連續全懸吊橋面：熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Continuous suspended deck: fuse restrainers and viscous dampers", which statement holds?
options: 深海的礫石墊層只是填料，平整度要求可以放寬。
感測器越多、取樣越快，監測系統就一定越有用。
optionsEn: Damper force F = C·v^α.
A deep-water gravel bed is just fill, so its flatness can be relaxed.
More sensors and faster sampling always make a monitoring system more useful.
quiz.explanationEn: Damper force F = C·v^α; with α = 0.15 and F = 3,500 kN at v = 1.6 m/s, C = 3,500/1.6^0.15 ≈ 3,262 kN/(m/s)^0.15, and at v = 0.1 m/s F ≈ 3,262×0.708 ≈ 2,309 kN: a sixteen-fold drop in speed lowers force by only about 34%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 連續全懸吊橋面：熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Continuous suspended deck: fuse restrainers and viscous dampers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「熔斷限制器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fuse restrainers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 熔斷元件以抽樣破壞試驗確認斷開力在設計範圍內，阻尼器做全尺寸力—速度與行程試驗；營運期以限制器上的荷重計長期記錄風力與溫度造成的力，確認遠低於熔斷值；地震後依荷重計資料判斷是否需要更換熔斷元件並重新校準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm fuse break force by sample destructive tests and test dampers full-size for force–velocity and stroke; in service record wind- and temperature-induced forces on the restrainer load cells to confirm they stay well below the fuse value, and after an earthquake use the load-cell data to decide whether fuses must be replaced and recalibrated. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：熔斷元件應設計為地震後可快速更換的消耗件，並在現場或倉庫保留備品；監測系統要把限制器荷重與阻尼器行程列為事件後自動報告的必要內容。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design fuses as sacrificial parts that can be replaced quickly after an earthquake, keep spares on site or in store, and make restrainer loads and damper strokes mandatory content of automatic post-event reports.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：熔斷值設得太低，強風或溫度力就會讓限制器斷開，橋面在日常風中擺動；設得太高，地震時不斷開，巨大的慣性力經限制器傳到塔與基礎。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A fuse set too low breaks in strong wind or under temperature force and lets the deck swing in everyday wind; set too high it does not break in an earthquake and sends huge inertia forces through to the pylons and foundations; insufficient damper stroke can hit the end stops late in a major quake. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 熔斷元件以抽樣破壞試驗確認斷開力在設計範圍內，阻尼器做全尺寸力—速度與行程試驗；營運期以限制器上的荷重計長期記錄風力與溫度造成的力，確認遠低於熔斷值；地震後依荷重計資料判斷是否需要更換熔斷元件並重新校準。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm fuse break force by sample destructive tests and test dampers full-size for force–velocity and stroke; in service record wind- and temperature-induced forces on the restrainer load cells to confirm they stay well below the fuse value, and after an earthquake use the load-cell data to decide whether fuses must be replaced and recalibrated.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 熔斷元件應設計為地震後可快速更換的消耗件，並在現場或倉庫保留備品；監測系統要把限制器荷重與阻尼器行程列為事件後自動報告的必要內容。
knowledge.textEn: Design fuses as sacrificial parts that can be replaced quickly after an earthquake, keep spares on site or in store, and make restrainer loads and damper strokes mandatory content of automatic post-event reports.

quiz.question: 要驗證「連續全懸吊橋面：熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Continuous suspended deck: fuse restrainers and viscous dampers"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
熔斷元件以抽樣破壞試驗確認斷開力在設計範圍內，阻尼器做全尺寸力—速度與行程試驗。
斜索是由許多鋼絞線組成的，所以整根斜索不可能突然失效。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Confirm fuse break force by sample destructive tests and test dampers full-size for force–velocity and stroke.
Because a stay is made of many strands, the whole stay can never fail suddenly.
quiz.explanation: 熔斷元件以抽樣破壞試驗確認斷開力在設計範圍內，阻尼器做全尺寸力—速度與行程試驗；營運期以限制器上的荷重計長期記錄風力與溫度造成的力，確認遠低於熔斷值；地震後依荷重計資料判斷是否需要更換熔斷元件並重新校準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm fuse break force by sample destructive tests and test dampers full-size for force–velocity and stroke; in service record wind- and temperature-induced forces on the restrainer load cells to confirm they stay well below the fuse value, and after an earthquake use the load-cell data to decide whether fuses must be replaced and recalibrated. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 連續全懸吊橋面：熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Continuous suspended deck: fuse restrainers and viscous dampers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熔斷限制器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fuse restrainers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 熔斷值設得太低，強風或溫度力就會讓限制器斷開，橋面在日常風中擺動；設得太高，地震時不斷開，巨大的慣性力經限制器傳到塔與基礎。阻尼器行程不足則可能在大地震末段撞擊止擋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A fuse set too low breaks in strong wind or under temperature force and lets the deck swing in everyday wind; set too high it does not break in an earthquake and sends huge inertia forces through to the pylons and foundations; insufficient damper stroke can hit the end stops late in a major quake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：熔斷限制器提供常時剛度，阻尼器在熔斷後限制擺幅並消耗能量，兩者分工讓風與地震的需求不必用同一個元件妥協。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The fuses provide everyday stiffness and the dampers limit swing and dissipate energy after the fuses break, so wind and seismic demands need not be compromised in one device.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋面懸吊在塔上自由擺動，地震時就不需要任何阻尼裝置。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the deck hangs freely from the pylons, it needs no damping devices in an earthquake." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 熔斷值設得太低，強風或溫度力就會讓限制器斷開，橋面在日常風中擺動；設得太高，地震時不斷開，巨大的慣性力經限制器傳到塔與基礎。阻尼器行程不足則可能在大地震末段撞擊止擋。
knowledge.textEn: A fuse set too low breaks in strong wind or under temperature force and lets the deck swing in everyday wind; set too high it does not break in an earthquake and sends huge inertia forces through to the pylons and foundations; insufficient damper stroke can hit the end stops late in a major quake.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「連續全懸吊橋面：熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Continuous suspended deck: fuse restrainers and viscous dampers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
軟弱海床上的大橋基礎一定要用長樁打到岩盤。
熔斷值設得太低，強風或溫度力就會讓限制器斷開，橋面在日常風中擺動；設得太高，地震時不斷開，巨大的慣性力經限制器傳到塔與基礎。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Bridge foundations on soft seabed must always use long piles driven to rock.
A fuse set too low breaks in strong wind or under temperature force and lets the deck swing in everyday wind.
quiz.explanation: 熔斷值設得太低，強風或溫度力就會讓限制器斷開，橋面在日常風中擺動；設得太高，地震時不斷開，巨大的慣性力經限制器傳到塔與基礎。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A fuse set too low breaks in strong wind or under temperature force and lets the deck swing in everyday wind; set too high it does not break in an earthquake and sends huge inertia forces through to the pylons and foundations; insufficient damper stroke can hit the end stops late in a major quake. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
